name: Sergeant Festgefroren
personality: Keeps moving chiefly to avoid becoming another landmark.
visual_intent: low broad ink splat, plain khaki steel helmet, small quilted shoulder patch and folded map; one eyebrow high, long stubborn toothless closed mouth
biography: Keeps moving chiefly to avoid becoming another landmark. He folds a HyperNorm map along boundaries that keep moving overnight. A dissonant card remembers where the stairwell used to be. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Standpunkt bleibt beweglich bis zum Gegenbefehl.

name: Späherin Weitsicht
personality: Notices the small detail missing from every grand plan.
visual_intent: tall hooked pear blob, plain soft khaki cap and tiny grey scarf, compact scoped wood-stock rifle vertical beside body; lashes, one sharp eye one lifted lid, confident lopsided open grin with one upper tooth
biography: Notices the small detail missing from every grand plan. Her scope notices the frightened HyperNorm neighbour hidden behind a triumphant briefing. She lowers the rifle whenever certainty looks too easy. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Detail widerspricht leider dem Gesamtbild.

name: Funkerina Rauschen
personality: Translates static into something headquarters will accept.
visual_intent: round top-heavy splat, plain sidecap and little headset, compact radio handset and small paper strip; lashes, huge startled eyes looking at paper, open oval mouth with no teeth
biography: Translates static into something headquarters will accept. She reads HyperNorm message strips that make perfect sense until placed together. A dissonant card asks her to keep the scraps. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Meldung ist vollständig. Der Zusammenhang fehlt.

name: Tankist Rückwärtsgang
personality: Can hear an engine requesting permission to give up.
visual_intent: squat bulbous ink blob, dark ribbed padded tanker helmet, goggles above forehead, oversized short spanner; sleepy heavy lids and crooked closed toothless smirk
biography: Can hear an engine requesting permission to give up. His padded cap muffles the HyperNorm engine and very little of the management. A dissonant card recommends listening the other way round. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Motor schweigt aus eigener Sachkenntnis.

name: Infanterist Nurweiter
personality: Finds courage whenever somebody smaller is watching.
visual_intent: lean leaning splat, battered plain steel helmet, simple canvas satchel and wood-stock carbine safely up at side; broad bellowing open mouth with two upper teeth and one eye squeezed smaller
biography: Finds courage whenever somebody smaller is watching. He carries courage through HyperNorm in a satchel officially assigned to spare certainty. A dissonant card makes room for doubt. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Weitergehen gilt zunächst nur für die Füße, die er nicht hat.

name: Versorger Letzterrest
personality: Distributes the last portion with the optimism of a man expecting another.
visual_intent: round irregular blob, soft fur-edged earflap cap, small metal kettle and ration ledger; raised mournful brows and tiny toothless downturn
biography: Distributes the last portion with the optimism of a man expecting another. His kettle warms HyperNorm portions that exist on paper before arriving in cupboards. A dissonant card saves a cup for a late neighbour. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der letzte Rest wurde fürsorglich mehrfach verplant.
